summary: This code imports a helper function that customizes OpenAPI documentation for a FastAPI application, then calls that function and passes the FastAPI app object to it so the documentation gets configured with whatever custom settings are defined in that helper.

explanations.1: This imports a specific function called configure_custom_openapi from a helpers module that presumably contains code to modify how FastAPI generates its API documentation.
explanations.11: This actually runs the configure_custom_openapi function, passing in the app object so the function can modify the FastAPI application's OpenAPI behavior.
